title: Korda Kable Leadcore Leader Hybrid Lead Clip QC Swivel 50cm - Gravel

longDescription: Kable Leadcore Leader Hybrid Lead Clip QC Swivel 50cm It would be almost impossible to make our ready tied leadcore leaders any more user-friendly, but we’ve managed it by creating a quick change (QC) version. These QC ready-tied leadcore leaders are as good as anything that you can construct yourself and save you the time, effort and any element of doubt that you’ve done it correctly. Each leader is constructed using the new Tight Weave Kable Leadcore and ready to use straight out of the packet. A QC Hybrid Lead Clip is spliced to one end and a spliced loop formed at the other so that it can quickly be attached and detached from your main line as required. Simply attach the leader to your main line, use the QC attachment for your hook link, put a lead on and you’re ready to cast out! Each pack contains three QC Hybrid Lead Clip leaders, in a choice of Weed Green or Gravel Brown colours. Also available in Heli-Safe, Hybrid Ring Swivel, QC and Ring Swivel versions. longDescription: The hugely effective D-rig doesn’t really need to much of an introduction. title: Korda COG Boom QC Flat Pear Leads - 6/8oz
description: Our COG leads are designed to be fished in a specific way to ensure that when a fish moves the lead it feels as much of it as soon as possible, hence them being called ‘Centre of G
longDescription: Our COG leads are designed to be fished in a specific way to ensure that when a fish moves the lead it feels as much of it as soon as possible, hence them being called ‘Centre of Gravity’ leads. To ensure that they work effectively you will need to fish them with a Centre of Gravity System booms.The COG leads are designed to be used in conjunction with a Lead Clip, and the boom, which is constructed from spliced leadcore, with a swivel at one end which attaches to your main line and fits into the nose of the Lead Clip. At the other end of the boom there is a special swivel with the bottom eye removed, so that the barrel fits perfectly into the grommet in the centre of the COG lead.This quick change version, incorporates a Size 11 QC swivel and anti-tangle sleeve. Perfect for leaving your hook length inside the boat while you row out to your spot. Once in position, just clip on your rig, secure with the anti-tangle sleeve and drop in to position.Available in 3 sizes to fit Flat Pear COG leads from 3oz up to 8oz.

longDescription: We have now added a Hybrid Lead Clip QC version to our popular range of Dark Matter fused leaders, to allow you to quickly change your hook link in as hassle-free a way as possible, whenever you choose to. Each pack contains one leader.

longDescription: The Pro-Active Particle & Pellet Syrup range has been specifically formulated to draw fish into the baited area and induce a competitive feeding response. The thick, syrupy liquid is designed to be denser than water - dispersing as it reaches the bottom and spreading a highly attractive cloud back to the surface. This ensures that fish are attracted from all levels in the water column, as well as from distance. Pro-Active Particle & Pellet Syrups contain liquid palatants, aminos and natural sugars all of which are highly effective and well-proven feeding stimulants. The Syrup is convenient, easy to use and completely water soluble – not to mention completely PVA friendly! Meaning you can combine these reliable liquids with any presentation. Designed to boost the attraction of prepared particles or pellets and to be a highly effective groundbait additive. Recommended dosage is 10mm per 1kg, but the natural attractors used make it impossible to overdose. longDescription: The triple core technology in Technium mono has always made this one of the best lines on the market but new Japanese technologies have made it not only thinner but stronger!!A triple core construction not only provides excellent strength but reduces the stretch of the line as the center layer is solid, most mono's stretch 25%+, Technium around 12%! This not only vastly increasing casting distance, it makes bite detection much sharper without the fear of fish loss. The solid center gives this line its excellent sinking properties. The 2nd layer gives the line its suppleness, which is apparent the second you take it off the spool. From the first cast the lack of memory makes reaching great distances effortless, the lack of coiling again only aids bite detection. A final ultra thin layer of UV protection is applied this gives the line its silky smooth finish, again aiding casting and ensures the lines longevity, something Shimano are synonymous for within the reel industry.
